status: EXCLUDED: native recertification blocked by archived checker
proof_of_candidate_semantics: Both constructors tile the grid with axis-aligned rectangles. Native: a 2x2 grid with distinct colours; canonical fixtures merge equal adjacent colours into rectangles. RE-ARC: guillotine cuts that give each piece a new distinct colour. The noise colour differs from every region colour.

Removing the true noise colour N: RE-ARC puts noise only in backdrop(inbox(obj)), so each region keeps its whole border and its box is exactly its rectangle; the boxes tile. Native dots may lie on region edges. A tiling is still found unless one full edge line of a region is all dots, in which case the program raises.

No other colour X qualifies. Removing X needs N's box to contain only N or X, so all noise lies inside X's region, strictly inside the border in RE-ARC. X's border ring is then uncovered and the tiling fails. Natively, at least 3 quadrants have dots, so N's box crosses region boundaries.
If the tiling holds, each box lies inside its true rectangle and the boxes cover the grid. So every box equals its rectangle and each dot is counted in its true region.
Unique maximum: native counts are distinct samples from range(6); RE-ARC decrements every tied maximum except the first. Ties are rejected regardless.
